entities.primaryName: Jaringan wakil Ahmad Khatib & penyebaran TQN
entities.subtitle: Setelah 1878 — Banten, Cirebon, Madura, Bali, Kedah, Lampung, Palembang, Sambas
entities.summary: Per the official Suryalaya record, Syaikh Ahmad Khatib appointed many deputies who spread the combined order in their respective regions: Syaikh Abdul Karim of Banten, Syaikh Ahmad Thalhah of Cirebon, Syaikh Ahmad Hasbullah of Madura, Muhammad Isma’il Ibn Abdul Rahim of Bali, Syaikh Yasin of Kedah (Malaysia), Syaikh Haji Ahmad of Lampung, and Syaikh Muhammad Makruf Ibn Abdullah al-Khatib of Palembang. In Sambas itself the spread was carried by Syaikh Nuruddin (from the Philippines) and Syaikh Muhammad Sa’ad. After his death (1878), Syaikh Tholhah bin Talabudin continued the development from Trusmi, Kalisapu, Cirebon.

Di Sambas sendiri penyebarannya dilakukan Syaikh Nuruddin (dari Filipina) dan Syaikh Muhammad Sa’ad. Setelah wafatnya (1878), Syaikh Tholhah bin Talabudin melanjutkan pengembangan dari Trusmi, Kalisapu, Cirebon.

Its silent dhikr (dhikr al-qalb) later met the vocal dhikr of the Qadiriyya in the combined TQN.

entities.summary: Sufi master from Sambas (West Kalimantan) who taught in Mecca and is accepted as the articulator of the combined order Qadiriyah wa Naqsyabandiyah in the 19th century.
